# Exhibit Graphic Sign (EGS)

> In-house Dubai design and fabrication house for custom exhibition stands, institutional ceremonies, retail rollouts, signage, and commercial interior fitouts across the UAE and Saudi Arabia since 2010.

## Overview & Entity Facts
- **Organization Name:** Exhibit Graphic Sign (EGS)
- **Founding Year:** 2010
- **Headquarters & Fabrication Workshop:** Al Qusais Industrial Area, Dubai & Sharjah, United Arab Emirates
- **Primary Geographies:** Dubai (DWTC, Dubai Harbour), Abu Dhabi (ADNEC), Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain, Riyadh (Saudi Arabia).
- **Direct Phone:** +971 4 238 3278 / +971 52 458 7992
- **Official Email:** info@exhibitgraphicsign.com
- **Website:** https://www.exhibitgraphicsign.com/

## Core Services & Capabilities
- [Custom Exhibition Stand Design & Build](https://www.exhibitgraphicsign.com/exhibition-stand-contractor-dubai): In-house joinery, steelwork, acrylic fabrication, large-format graphics, DWTC/ADNEC permit management, double-decker structural approvals, and turnkey trade show handover.
- [Institutional Staging & Graduation Ceremonies](https://www.exhibitgraphicsign.com/graduation-stage-setup-uae): Heavy-duty certified staging, high-resolution curved LED video walls, VIP royal protocol seating, and line-array audio for university convocations (e.g. Higher Colleges of Technology).
- [Retail Rollouts & POSM Fabrication](https://www.exhibitgraphicsign.com/pos-display-stands-dubai): Custom free-standing display units (FSDUs), supermarket chiller branding, and overnight multi-store installations across hypermarket chains (Carrefour, LuLu).
- [Commercial Fitouts & Architectural Signage](https://www.exhibitgraphicsign.com/signage-manufacturer-dubai): 3D illuminated LED channel letters, reception joinery, corporate wayfinding signage, and municipal permit handling.

## Verified Track Record & Proof
- **Higher Colleges of Technology (HCT):** 7+ consecutive years delivering multi-campus graduation ceremonies across 5 Emirates, handling up to 5,000+ graduates per cycle with zero missed showtimes.
- **Sadia / Carrefour UAE:** Overnight nationwide retail rollout across 33 Carrefour hypermarkets completed between midnight and 6:00 AM using 13 dedicated vehicles.
- **Philips Healthcare (Riyadh & Dubai):** Turnkey 200 sqm medical exhibition booth delivered and adapted on-site in 10-12 hours for specialized diagnostic equipment.
- **Kazakhstan National Pavilion (Gulfood DWTC):** 168 sqm country pavilion constructed with unified overhead branding and 5-6 overnight chiller additions before opening.

- [DWTC Exhibition Stand Guidelines & Regulations](https://www.exhibitgraphicsign.com/guides/dwtc-stand-guidelines): Technical manual covering DWTC maximum build heights, double-decker structural engineering calculations, Civil Defence fire-retardant compliance, and ceiling rigging rules.
- [GITEX Global Stand Builder](https://www.exhibitgraphicsign.com/events/gitex-exhibition-stands): Tech booth design, LED walls, and demo pods for GITEX at DWTC.
- [Arab Health Stand Contractor](https://www.exhibitgraphicsign.com/events/arab-health-exhibition-stands): Clinical-grade booths and heavy diagnostic equipment reinforcement for Arab Health at DWTC.
- [Gulfood Stand Builder](https://www.exhibitgraphicsign.com/events/gulfood-exhibition-stands): Food sampling counters and national country pavilions for Gulfood at DWTC.
